|strategy=By [mailto:jralrea@ilstu.edu Joe Alread]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/dark/small/counterattack.html</ref>

Why battle once when you can battle twice? [[Counterattack]] makes this possible, and it has the capability of throwing a real wrench into the opponent's plan for figuring out whether it's worth it to battle you at a specific time or not. Especially if your running troopers as well, since two destiny draws in a second battle can account for some serious attrition, since your opponent has already lost someone

to battle you again, for fear of you striking back! This comes into it's own if you are stocking any weapons also, as it gives you another chance to pick off a few characters before your next turn, where you can go at them again.
|rulings=* Allows cards to participate in another battle and fire weapons again.<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Counterattack</ref>
* Does not allow cards to 'react' a second time in one turn.
* The player who played this Interrupt initiated the battle and by default gets first action of each segment.
* A card excluded from the previous battle is not necessarily excluded from the new battle.
|counterpart=* [[Here We Go Again]]
